name: localvps
description: Turn your Mac/Windows PC into a VPS for AI agents: remote MCP server with built-in Cloudflare tunnel, token auth and a dashboard.

scripts.build:bin: node scripts/embed.mjs && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile release/localvps-macos-arm64 && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile release/localvps-macos-x64 && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile release/localvps-windows-x64.exe

author: hengfengliya
